run.warning_boundary: R reported 46 deferred warnings but did not emit their individual bodies. last.warning was not serialized. Count and this observation loss are retained; no source rerun or post-result options change was made.

numerical_inspection.reference_comparison: Fresh simstudy.rds versus evaluator-only cached author simstudy.rds, joined by SimFn, Function and SimNumber. No cached output was copied into execution.
numerical_inspection.timing_scope: Five sample sizes, nine prior families, twenty timings per cell. Hardware-specific timings are not required to equal the author archive and are not agent costs.
numerical_inspection.inspection_warning_boundary: Loading the saved workspace without its package library produced three namespace-replacement warnings; only already-stored numeric fields were read, not the replaced closures. Those logs remain unchanged. Future inspector startup now binds the owned library; the inspection was not rerun.

visual_inspection: All five single-page PDFs rendered and were inspected as nonblank labelled plots. Poppler emitted a Fontconfig configuration warning but rendered readable labels. The HTML has ten result rows and its numerical source was inspected; browser layout was not verified.

authority.remaining_scope: Appendix, full million-observation timing study, full warning bodies, hidden evaluation tasks and tolerances, fresh-family assignment and independent mathematical authority are not established. The reference cannot by itself accept a future candidate or justify an efficacy claim.
